quotes.text: "Adding a folder should not refresh UI state on every folder row"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: onFolderAdded sets the new folder sort order and adds it without calling updateFolderRowUIElements. The new regression task wraps that helper, creates a local folder and directly asserts that its row exists and the global helper was not called. This checks a narrow call contract, not rendering speed, all server modes or dynamic accessible-label correctness.
title: The folder-add regression test counts global row refresh calls
